evals.prompt: Map this synthetic support agent from supplied evidence only. Owner-approved scope: app.example.test and its retrieval service; no network tests. Roles: customer and support operator. A design note dated 2026-10-23 says the agent retrieves tenant documents and calls a refund tool as a service account. A saved CSP mentions metrics.vendor.test; ownership and permission for that host are unknown. Return the map and register in chat.
evals.expected_output: A scoped web/GenAI/RAG/agent map and a prioritized tenant, refund-authority and third-party-data backlog with unexecuted checks.
assertions: Retains all supplied system types and boundaries
Does not expand scope to metrics.vendor.test
Separates design evidence from verified runtime behavior
Links every priority to assets and a secure expectation
